decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered 3345P.02A, P.03, P.05,P.06, P.07, P.08, P.09, P.10, P.11, and numbered P.04A and P.11A  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment produced by Baker Consulting Limited (reference 3345/3.1FRA/DL) and the basement shall not be occupied until all the measures in the Flood Risk Assessment are implemented.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a ground and first floor rear extension, enlargement of basement incorporating front and rear lightwells, and erection of new front entrance gates to the house
